title: Signal Current — 2026-09-08: AI is getting cheaper, but trust is the real cost center
description: This week’s big tension: capability is advancing fast, yet the reputational and operational risk is still what leaders have to govern—not what models can do. OpenAI is explicitly pitching more capable, more affordable AI “within reach,” while also expanding journalism support and rolling out new model/safety work—raising the stakes for how brands and agencies operationalize reliability, attribution, and cyber hygiene.
